limits: The permanent-delete browser dialog was not exercised. Only exact new fixtures were deleted through the protected REST API.
Browser testing used two sessions of the same owner; cross-owner isolation and Agents access were tested by live API CI.
Notifications update the open signed-in website; operating-system notification popups are not requested.
